programme.desc: Adopted by her aunt, young Cameron turns to her faith when she finds herself imprisoned in a house of horrors with no human contact.

programme.title: Held Hostage in My House
programme.desc: A single mother wakes up to find herself hogtied and held captive at her country vacation rental by an unknown assailant. She must piece together clues from the previous guests to find out who is behind this.

programme.title: The Neighbor Who Saw Too Much
programme.desc: A teen becomes convinced that her new neighbor is actually a dangerous killer. However, when no one else believes her, she takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Behind Closed Doors
programme.desc: A murder suspect on the run forces his way into Morgan's home and holds her family captive. She does everything she can to keep them safe, but it seems his arrival at her door may not have been so random after all.

programme.title: Kidnapped in Her Own Home: The Martha Carelli Story
programme.desc: Martha Carelli's quiet life is shattered when an escaped convict hiding in her basement takes her hostage. Forced to drive his getaway car, she finds herself trapped in a dangerous psychological battle where survival depends on courage and cunning.

programme.title: No One Leaves
programme.desc: When Meredith and her husband go to their neighbor's farm for dinner, he introduces them to his visiting niece. But as the evening progresses, Meredith starts to suspect the young woman isn't his niece, but his captive.

programme.title: Kidnapped by a Killer: The Heather Robinson Story
programme.desc: Fifteen-year-old Heather Robinson's world comes crashing down when the man she knew as her uncle, John Robinson, is arrested for the murders of multiple women in the Kansas City area, including her biological mother.

programme.title: Mr. Blandings Builds His Dream House
programme.desc: A New York adman (Cary Grant) and his calm wife (Myrna Loy) buy a big old fixer-upper in rural Connecticut.

programme.title: The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
programme.desc: A judge (Myrna Loy) orders a playboy (Cary Grant) to date her infatuated teenage sister (Shirley Temple) to cure the girl's crush on him.

programme.title: Third Finger, Left Hand
programme.desc: An artist (Melvyn Douglas) moves in with a magazine editor (Myrna Loy) whose job depends on the pretense of a husband.

programme.title: So Goes My Love
programme.desc: Eccentric British inventor Hiram Maxim (Don Ameche) and his bride (Myrna Loy) raise a son (Bobby Driscoll) in late-1800s Brooklyn.

programme.title: A Successful Calamity
programme.desc: A financier (George Arliss) comes home and tells his wife (Mary Astor), son and daughter (Evalyn Knapp) he is broke to get their attention.

programme.title: Turn Back the Clock
programme.desc: A cigar-store keeper (Lee Tracy) dreams of what his life would have been like with power, prestige and a rich wife.

programme.title: The Millionaire
programme.desc: An incognito auto tycoon (George Arliss) works at a gas station with a student (David Manners) who loves the tycoon's daughter (Evalyn Knapp).

programme.title: Tycoon
programme.desc: An engineer (John Wayne) woos the daughter (Laraine Day) of a tycoon (Cedric Hardwicke) who has hired him to build a railroad in the Andes.

programme.title: Silver Dollar
programme.desc: A farmer (Edward G. Robinson) strikes Colorado silver, enters politics and leaves his wife (Aline MacMahon) for a blonde (Bebe Daniels).

programme.title: The World Changes
programme.desc: A young Midwesterner (Paul Muni) becomes a meat tycoon with a socialite wife (Mary Astor).

programme.title: Boom Town
programme.desc: Texas wildcatters (Clark Gable, Spencer Tracy) hit oil together, then fight after one marries the other's sweetheart (Claudette Colbert).

programme.title: The Enchanted Cottage
programme.desc: A disfigured veteran (Robert Young) and his homely bride (Dorothy McGuire) look beautiful to each other in a seaside cottage.

programme.title: Desire Me
programme.desc: A Frenchwoman's (Greer Garson) husband (Robert Mitchum), thought to be dead, returns from war and finds her in love with one (Richard Hart) of his comrades.

programme.title: The Great Lie
programme.desc: A lost aviator's (George Brent) socialite wife (Bette Davis) makes a deal with a pianist (Mary Astor) having his baby.

programme.title: Random Harvest
programme.desc: An amnesiac World War I British veteran (Ronald Colman) marries a chorus girl (Greer Garson), then forgets her.

programme.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
programme.desc: A young Englishwoman (Wendy Hiller) aims to marry a tycoon but finds love with a naval officer (Roger Livesey) instead.

programme.title: Dark Victory
programme.desc: An heiress (Bette Davis) with only months to live embarks on a social whirl, then marries her doctor (George Brent).

programme.title: They Learned About Women
programme.desc: Lured by the glamour of the stage, two professional baseball players turn in their uniforms for careers in vaudeville.

programme.title: Alibi Ike
programme.desc: An eccentric ballplayer known for his unorthodox pitching style finds major-league trouble with a girl and gangsters.

programme.title: The Big Leaguer
programme.desc: Young players try out for the founder (Edward G. Robinson) of the New York Giants Florida training camp.

programme.title: The Pride of the Yankees
programme.desc: Lou Gehrig (Gary Cooper) leads the New York baseball team for years and then, slowly dying, retires with a stadium farewell.

programme.title: The Winning Team
programme.desc: Grover Cleveland Alexander (Ronald Reagan) becomes one of baseball's greatest pitchers, with his wife's (Doris Day) support.

programme.title: Angels in the Outfield
programme.desc: The Pittsburgh Pirates' manager (Paul Douglas) sees hope after a newswoman (Janet Leigh) reports a girl saw angels on their side.

programme.title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
programme.desc: Two dancing baseball players (Gene Kelly, Frank Sinatra) run into trouble with their team's new female owner (Esther Williams) and a gambler who doesn't want them to win the pennant.

programme.title: The Jackie Robinson Story
programme.desc: After a successful baseball career in college and as a coach in the military, Jackie Robinson attracts the attention of Major League Baseball's Branch Rickey.

programme.title: Sergeant Rutledge
programme.desc: A cavalry officer (Jeffrey Hunter) defends a sergeant (Woody Strode) accused of rape and a double murder.

programme.title: The Harlem Globetrotters
programme.desc: An athlete drops out of college to join Abe Saperstein's basketball team.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: Set during the Civil War, Colonel John Marlowe leads a Union Calvary brigade on a mission behind Confederate lines to destroy enemy railroads and supplies. The colonel is confronted with numerous challenges before reaching Union held Baton Rouge.

programme.title: The Fish That Saved Pittsburgh
programme.desc: An astrologer (Stockard Channing) helps a water boy (James Bond III) match players to his basketball team's star (Julius Erving), whose sign is Pisces.

programme.title: MGM Parade Show
programme.desc: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

programme.title: Law of the Tropics
programme.desc: A nightclub singer (Constance Bennett) marries a jilted rubber salesman (Jeffrey Lynn) in the Amazon.

programme.title: After Office Hours
programme.desc: A managing editor (Clark Gable) sends a socialite reporter (Constance Bennett) to spy on her boyfriend, mixed up in murder.

programme.title: What Price Hollywood?
programme.desc: A director (Lowell Sherman) on a drunken slide makes a Brown Derby waitress (Constance Bennett) a star.

programme.title: Bed of Roses
programme.desc: Two wayward women (Constance Bennett, Pert Kelton) go down the Mississippi by steamboat, looking for men to fleece.

programme.title: Wild Bill Hickok Rides
programme.desc: Wild Bill (Bruce Cabot) and a casino queen (Constance Bennett) thwart a river-basin land-grabber (Warren William) working for Chicago big shots.

programme.title: The Unsuspected
programme.desc: The narrator (Claude Rains) of a murder-mystery radio show is a killer, but his niece (Joan Caulfield) would never know it.

programme.title: Smart Woman
programme.desc: A special prosecutor (Brian Aherne) falls in love with the lawyer (Constance Bennett) he opposes in a racketeer's murder trial.

programme.title: Topper
programme.desc: The ghosts of socialites George (Cary Grant) and Marion (Constance Bennett) decide to help their friend, banker Cosmo Topper (Roland Young).

programme.title: Topper Takes a Trip
programme.desc: The ghosts of socialite Marion (Constance Bennett) and her dog, Skippy, help Cosmo Topper (Roland Young) with his wife (Billie Burke) on the Riviera.

programme.title: The Snake Pit
programme.desc: A man (Mark Stevens) commits his wife (Olivia de Havilland) to a mental hospital, where her doctor (Leo Genn) tries the latest therapy.

programme.title: Suddenly, Last Summer
programme.desc: A New Orleans matriarch (Katharine Hepburn) tries to bribe a brain surgeon (Montgomery Clift) to lobotomize her niece (Elizabeth Taylor) who witnessed a murder.

programme.title: Torture Garden
programme.desc: Sideshow mystic Dr. Diablo (Burgess Meredith) shows an Edgar Allan Poe fan (Jack Palance) and other after-hours patrons their futures.

programme.title: The Night House
programme.desc: Reeling from the unexpected death of her husband, Beth is left alone at the lakeside home he built for her. She tries her best to keep it together, but disturbing visions of a presence in the house call to her, beckoning Beth with a ghostly allure.

programme.title: Spiral: From the Book of Saw
programme.desc: Detective Banks and his partner take charge of an investigation into grisly murders that are eerily reminiscent of the city's gruesome past. Unwittingly entrapped in a deepening mystery, Banks finds himself at the center of the killer's morbid game.

programme.title: The Black Rose
programme.desc: Saxon Walter of Gurnie and medieval bowman Tristram join a warlord going to see Kublai Khan.

programme.title: Berlin Correspondent
programme.desc: A U.S. radio commentator (Dana Andrews) sneaks his girlfriend (Virginia Gilmore), her father and vital data out of Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Decision Before Dawn
programme.desc: A German prisoner (Oskar Werner) agrees to spy for the Allies and joins a U.S. officer (Richard Basehart) behind enemy lines.

programme.title: Hell and High Water
programme.desc: A scientist (Victor Francen) and his colleagues hire an ex-Navy officer (Richard Widmark) to prevent World War III with a submarine.

programme.title: The Quiller Memorandum
programme.desc: A British spy chief (Alec Guinness) in Berlin sends a U.S. agent (George Segal) to locate the head (Max von Sydow) of a neo-Nazi movement.

programme.title: The Kremlin Letter
programme.desc: American spies in Moscow to recover a stolen anti-Red China letter discover a traitor in their midst.

programme.title: Don't Breathe 2
programme.desc: Blind veteran Norman Nordstrom has been hiding out for several years in an isolated cabin with a young girl. When a group of unseemly criminals kidnaps her, he's forced to tap into even darker and more creative instincts in an effort to save her.

programme.title: The Grudge
programme.desc: Two detectives investigate a murder scene in a haunted house that passes on a ghostly curse to those who dare enter it.

programme.title: Prometheus
programme.desc: A clue to mankind's origins leads a team of explorers to deep space, where they must fight a terrifying battle to save the future of the human race.

programme.title: Alien: Covenant
programme.desc: Crew members (Katherine Waterston, Billy Crudup) of the colony ship Covenant encounter a hostile alien life-form after traveling to a dark and dangerous planet on the far side of the galaxy.

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: Thirty years ago, Clifford McBride led a voyage into space, but the ship and crew were never heard from again. Now his son must embark on a daring mission to uncover the truth about his father and a mysterious power surge that threatens the universe.

programme.title: Machete
programme.desc: Framed for a covert assassination, a blade-wielding former Federale (Danny Trejo) carves a path of blood, bullets and broken hearts as he carries out a mission of revenge.

programme.title: Blood and Sand
programme.desc: A Spanish matador (Tyrone Power) achieves fame but must choose between his wife (Linda Darnell) and mistress (Rita Hayworth).

programme.title: Down Argentine Way
programme.desc: A rich, blond New York show-jumper (Betty Grable) follows the son (Don Ameche) of a horse breeder back to Argentina.

programme.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
programme.desc: Two showgirls on the lookout for rich eligible bachelors run into numerous complications during a trip to Paris.

programme.title: How to Steal a Million
programme.desc: A detective (Peter O'Toole) helps a French art forger's daughter (Audrey Hepburn) steal a fake Venus.

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Hip Army surgeons Hawkeye (Donald Sutherland) and Trapper John (Elliott Gould) make their own rules in the chaos of Korea.

programme.title: Young Frankenstein
programme.desc: Respected medical lecturer Dr. Frederick Frankenstein (Gene Wilder) learns that he has inherited his infamous grandfather's estate in Transylvania. Arriving at the castle, Dr. Frankenstein soon begins to recreate his grandfather's experiments.

programme.title: The Watch
programme.desc: Four members of a neighborhood-watch group discover that their town has become overrun with aliens posing as ordinary suburbanites.

programme.title: Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem
programme.desc: Residents (Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth, John Ortiz) of a Colorado town become caught up in a longstanding war between two deadly alien races.

programme.title: Predator
programme.desc: On a mission in a Central American jungle, a team of commandos headed by Major Dutch Schaefer find themselves hunted by a fierce extra-terrestrial warrior.

programme.title: Predator 2
programme.desc: A police chief (Danny Glover) who learns that an invisible, extraterrestrial big game-hunting creature is killing criminals and cops also learns that he is to be its next target!

programme.title: Predators
programme.desc: In this new chapter in the Predator universe, a group of cold-blooded killers are brought together on an alien planet to be hunted by a new breed of alien Predators.

programme.title: Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem
programme.desc: Residents (Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth, John Ortiz) of a Colorado town become caught up in a longstanding war between two deadly alien races.

programme.title: The Alligator People
programme.desc: A nurse (Beverly Garland) tells psychiatrists how her husband (Richard Crane) was mutated by a mad scientist (George Macready) in the bayou.

programme.title: Soup to Nuts
programme.desc: Two guys and a girl run into Mexican rebels and lots of fires.

programme.title: High Anxiety
programme.desc: In a spoof of Hitchcock movies, a psychiatrist with vertigo takes over the Institute for the Very, Very Nervous.

programme.title: The Hot Rock
programme.desc: A thief (Robert Redford), his brother-in-law (George Segal) and their two helpers botch a diamond caper in New York.

programme.title: Eyewitness
programme.desc: Pretending to know something about a murder, a janitor (William Hurt) seduces a TV newswoman (Sigourney Weaver) but also becomes a target.

programme.title: Working Girl
programme.desc: A spunky Wall Street secretary (Melanie Griffith) takes her boss's (Sigourney Weaver) place with a merger specialist (Harrison Ford).

programme.title: Alien
programme.desc: Crew members aboard an interstellar freighter encounter a monster that crawls around their ship's dark corridors and service ducts as it kills them one by one.

programme.title: Aliens
programme.desc: Ripley reawakens from cryogenic sleep a half-century after a narrow escape from her alien foe, only to be sent to a remote colony to help battle an infestation of Xenomorphs.

programme.title: Alien 3
programme.desc: The survivor (Sigourney Weaver) of several alien attacks is the only woman on a prison planet with a doctor (Charles Dance), thugs, zealots and a horrific monster.

programme.title: Alien Resurrection
programme.desc: Two hundred years after she made the ultimate sacrifice, scientists clone Ripley and the Alien queen inside her.

programme.desc: Martha e Itzel son grandes amigas y están dispuestas a quedarse en el juego hasta el final para tratar de llevarse el automóvil.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Orlando descubre que mendigando en la calle saca una buena plata, pero una de sus hijas lo niega. Yuri y Magdalenys son dos niñas con un canal de modas en YouTube, pero quieren separarse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Chiquito rompecorazones; Solo quedan tres venas
programme.desc: Despiden al stripper José porque Jeffry se le lanzó encima y rompieron las tuberías del baño. Sofía es drogadicta y dejó a su hijo al cuidado de su abuela, pero ahora reclama la custodia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Ira en la carretera; La cazamaridos
programme.desc: Jeniset acusa a Jusset de tener relaciones con su marido, pero la amante de él es su hermana. Carmen fue víctima de la infidelidad de su esposo y ahora destruye los matrimonios de sus novios.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: Laura y Manuel son un matrimonio feliz que vive con sus dos hijas. En medio de un momento difícil para la familia, las dos jóvenes descubren un secreto que sus padres les han ocultado.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: La madre de Jovita le arrebató a su bebé cuando ella era apenas una adolescente. Pasaron muchos años antes de que pudiera reencontrarse con su hija Adriana, quien llena de rencor, la rechaza con dureza.

programme.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres
programme.sub-title: Giovanna, en la mira del peligro
programme.desc: Enamorada, Giovanna acepta la propuesta de Rodrigo de abrir una página para adultos. Por dinero, él decide ir más allá sin su consentimiento y cuando ella reclama, descubre que nunca hubo amor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Meditación tortuosa; El riñón es mío
programme.desc: El niño de Miriam tiene ataques de pánico desde que lo dejaron solo y a oscuras en una terapia. Mildrey viajó para hacerse una cirugía estética; de regreso descubre que le falta un riñón.

programme.title: Escape perfecto

programme.title: Un día para vivir
programme.desc: Adrián sufre un accidente automovilístico y pierde la memoria. Sin embargo, al enterarse de que le queda solo un día de vida, debe comenzar a armar un rompecabezas y descubrir la verdad.

programme.title: Acércate a Rocío
programme.sub-title: No me salen las cuentas, pero voy a ser papá
programme.desc: Juan duda de su paternidad, discute con su novia Nohemí y la corre de casa. Él cree que el bebé que viene en camino no es su hijo. La mamá de Juan apoya a Nohemí, convencida de que será abuela.

programme.title: Acércate a Rocío
programme.sub-title: Por codo se va a quedar solo
programme.desc: Areli está muy enojada con su hermano Eduardo porque se ha puesto tan tacaño que hasta les restringe la comida a sus hijos y esposa. También le corta el suministro de agua y otros servicios.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Con mis mejores amigos; Defecando en el restaurante
programme.desc: Tiene una hija con leucemia y ella le echa la culpa al padre. Ashley va al restaurante de Carlos con urgencia de ir al baño y al negárselo, no tiene más opción que defecar delante de todos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Odio latino; Metió preso a mi marido
programme.desc: El marido de Karla recibe una orden de deportación por culpa de Mirza, quien llamó a la policía porque ellos viven del gobierno. Leonel envía a la cárcel al esposo de Mariposa, su amante.

programme.title: Acércate a Rocío
programme.sub-title: Una vividora se aprovechó de mi hijo

programme.title: El zoo de Zu

programme.title: Los cazahogares en familia

programme.title: Los cazahogares en familia
programme.sub-title: Espacio para el bebé en Carolina del Norte

programme.title: Kilos mortales: Brasil
programme.desc: Carlos ha tenido obesidad desde que era niño y actualmente no encuentra una balanza que soporte su peso. Ante los problemas de salud que padece, la cirugía bariátrica es la única solución posible, pero no será fácil conseguirla.

programme.title: Kilos mortales: Brasil
programme.desc: Andrea pasa la mayor parte del tiempo acostada en la cama, sola, comiendo. Sin aliento ni energía para llevar una vida activa, ahora tiene graves problemas de salud. La cirugía bariátrica es su única esperanza.

programme.title: Kilos mortales: Brasil
programme.desc: Welton y Marcelo tienen obesidad mórbida. Welton ya no trabaja y no puede ponerse los zapatos sin ayuda. Marcelo sufre apnea, lo que afecta gravemente su salud. Para ambos, la cirugía bariátrica es la única solución para mejorar su calidad de vida.

programme.title: Kilos mortales: Brasil
programme.desc: Vanessa es madre de cinco hijos y la obesidad dificulta sus tareas diarias. Cuando el médico le dice que la situación es insostenible, Vanessa decide cambiar de estilo de vida. Ser persistente es la clave para superar sus problemas.

programme.title: Kilos mortales: Brasil
programme.desc: Rafael y Ana, una pareja de pastores, necesitan someterse a una cirugía bariátrica, pero les cuesta acostumbrarse a la disciplina necesaria. Ana inicia el proceso, hasta que llega el momento de que Rafael haga algo al respecto.

programme.title: Kilos mortales: Brasil
programme.desc: Fernando tiene enanismo y obesidad y considera que la cirugía bariátrica es su mejor opción para el futuro. Thaiane, por su parte, sufrió rechazo desde pequeña a causa de su obesidad y busca una cirugía bariátrica para sentirse bien con su cuerpo.

programme.title: Dra. Sandra Lee

programme.title: Dra. Sandra Lee

programme.title: Les Quiquoi

programme.title: Billy, le hamster cowboy
programme.desc: Jean-Claude reçoit une carte postale de son cousin Jean-Marc, un explorateur renommé, envoyé de Glasnia; croyant que Jean-Marc se trouve sur une montagne voisine, Jean-Claude part avec Billy et Suzie à sa recherche.

programme.title: Le refuge d'Audrey

programme.title: Le refuge d'Audrey
programme.desc: Audrey et Tommy font visiter le Refuge à Maeva, une camarade de classe ; mais Maeva se montre méprisante envers les animaux ; pour lui donner une leçon, ils lui font croire à l'existence d'une dangereuse créature vivant au Refuge.

programme.title: Escapades en Suisse italienne
programme.desc: En suivant le sentier de la transhumance, nous descendons dans la vallée depuis la ville fantôme de La Presa pour découvrir les ingénieuses prairies suspendues, construites sur des sommets presque inaccessibles; enfin, dégustation de pain typique.

programme.desc: Bruno Vespa approfondisce alcuni temi di attualità, cronaca, informazione politica, economica e di costume con gli ospiti presenti nel suo salotto.

programme.desc: La prima informazione del mattino che racconta l'attualità italiana ed estera. Cronaca, politica, cultura, spettacolo, medicina, economia, senza tralasciare l'approfondimento dei fatti più importanti.

programme.title: Unomattina
programme.desc: Spazi dedicati all'attualità, al costume e alla cultura si alternano alla rassegna stampa e alla discussione delle principali notizie.

programme.title: Storie italiane
programme.desc: Storie straordinarie e storie di ogni giorno si alternano e intrecciano in studio per raccontare l'Italia. I protagonisti raccontano le proprie vicende in prima persona, coadiuvati da giornalisti, esperti e inviati che commentano i fatti.

programme.title: Cinque minuti
programme.desc: Una nuova striscia informativa per raccontare l'Italia e il mondo giorno per giorno. Assistiamo a interviste a personaggi della politica interna e internazionale, del mondo artistico, culturale e dello spettacolo, tra temi sociali ed economici.

programme.title: Quante storie
programme.desc: Fatti, vicende, libri, film e mostre che raccontano i cambiamenti dell'Italia contemporanea. Tra interviste, dibattiti, recensioni e stroncature, è possibile osservare uno spaccato del paese.

programme.title: Paparazzi!

programme.title: Casa Italia
